info.title: WirePeek — local HTTP(S) capture proxy
info.description: A lightweight, Fiddler-like HTTP(S) capture tool for Windows. Runs a local MITM proxy and shows every outgoing request in a live web UI: full headers and decoded request/response bodies.

options.name: --proxy-port
options.description: Port the capture proxy listens on (default 8888)
